s_design.evidence_quote: This review will focus on the following topics:

domains.note: absence: read the whole text (Abstract, 1. Introduction, 2.1-2.5, 3. Conclusion, Ethical approval, Declaration of Competing Interest, References); there is no Methods section and no protocol, registration or PROSPERO wording anywhere

absence: no search strategy anywhere; Abstract, Introduction, sections 2.1-2.5 and Conclusion name no database (no PubMed/MEDLINE/Embase/Cochrane/Scopus), no search terms and no search dates; references are cited narratively

3b-iii line 3: neither (a) a screening account with counts (no PRISMA, no records screened/full texts assessed/included) nor (b) explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria; the only scoping statement is the topic list in the Abstract and Introduction ('For brevity, this review will focus on the following topics'), which is not an eligibility criterion; read Abstract, Introduction, 2.1-2.5, Conclusion

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: absence: no appraisal step in the text; read Abstract, Introduction, 2.1-2.5, Conclusion; no quality/bias/appraisal tool wording; the Introduction's general remark that most literature is clinical reports or opinions (citing Richards et al.) is a level-of-evidence comment about the field, not an appraisal of the cited studies
absence: no quantitative synthesis or statistical pooling anywhere in Abstract, Introduction, 2.1-2.5 or Conclusion; studies (e.g. Bellamy et al., Carvalho et al.) are summarised narratively
absence: no funnel plot, Egger test or publication-bias/small-study wording anywhere in Abstract, Introduction, 2.1-2.5, Conclusion

citation.title: Full-mouth rehabilitation in a skeletal Class III malocclusion patient with loss of occlusal vertical dimension due to mandibular posterior edentulism and severe tooth wear: a case report
citation.authors: Hyun-Jung Koo, Chang-Mo Jeong, So-Hyoun Lee
citation.journal: Journal of Korean Academy of Prosthodontics

s_design.anchor: single-patient case report of full-mouth prosthodontic rehabilitation (implant-supported posterior prostheses and zirconia crowns) with 1-year follow-up, no comparator (THERAPY case series / case report row, 30)
s_design.evidence_quote: 본 증례의 환자는 과도한 치아 마모 및 교합 수직 고경 상실

domains.note: Absence rating under FULL_TEXT: read 서론, 증례 (diagnosis, OVD evaluation, provisional phase, implant and definitive prosthesis, 1-year follow-up), 고찰 and 결론, plus the English and Korean abstracts; a single patient with no comparison group, and no adjustment, matching, restriction or stratification for any confounder (e.g. concurrent Botox injection, conservative/periodontal treatment, smile training) is described anywhere.
The patient and his presentation are described, but no criteria or reason for choosing this case for report are given.

domains.evidence_quote: Bilateral posterior occlusion was re-established with implant-supported
domains.note: Each treatment step (overlay denture, OVD increase, implants, zirconia restorations, occlusal scheme) is explicitly defined in the 증례 section.

domains.evidence_quote: 의 경과 관찰 시, 보철물 파절이나 탈락 및 턱관절의 이상 반응
domains.note: The single patient was followed and his outcomes are reported at the 1-year recall; no outcome data are missing for the one participant.

Outcomes are measured with cephalometric analysis, ISQ and clinical examination, but assessment was by the treating team with no blinding or independent assessor described, and satisfaction is reported informally.

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement anywhere in the text at all, or funding by a commercial manufacturer whose own product is among those tested, with no independent-analysis statement
penalties.note: Read the front-matter sidebar (correspondence, article history, funding), the body and the Korean abstract block; only a university funding line appears (Pusan National University 2-Year Research Grant), and no conflict-of-interest or competing-interest statement exists anywhere. 8 × 30 / 100 = 2.4, rounded to 2.

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: Not applicable: single-patient case report, not an RCT.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis (clinical studies); for in-vitro, specimen count per group <10 with no justification
penalties.note: Clinical study with one patient and no sample-size justification anywhere in the text; 5 × 30 / 100 = 1.5, rounded half up to 2.

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires (e.g. survival claims with <3y follow-up)
penalties.note: Absence of prosthesis fracture/debonding and stable maintenance of the OVD increase are claimed on 1 year of follow-up, shorter than 3 years; 3 × 30 / 100 = 0.9, floored to 1.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز شواهد این منبع ۱۲ از ۱۰۰ و باند E است؛ نوع سوال Therapy است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این متن گزارش درمان یک بیمار Class III اسکلتال با افزایش OVD و بازسازی کامل دهان است، بدون گروه مقایسه و با یک سال پیگیری. ارزشش در نشان دادن مسیر تشخیص OVD، دوره‌ی پروویژنال با overlay denture و طراحی اکلوژن در Class III است. نتیجه‌گیری درباره‌ی اثربخشی یا پایداری بلندمدت از آن درنمی‌آید.
